diagnosis: The endpoint reads job execution status and payload data directly from the agendaJobs collection using jobId. It does not check if job.data.userId matches req.user.id, leaking job payloads (which frequently contain private auth tokens, email addresses, and parameters) across users.
exploit_request:
GET /api/scheduler/jobs/65b1298e09f12a9001f80129/logs HTTP/1.1
Host: scheduler.platform.internal
Authorization: Bearer <user_token>
